title: Quantization Profile Library — Model Coverage & Readiness (working sheet)
content:
Context / how to use this sheet
- Goal: track which model variants we plan to publish quantization profiles for in v1, and what’s currently safe to expose behind the route-level toggle.
- Readiness definitions (rough):
  - Candidate: profile exists locally; not yet through full eval harness.
  - Eval running: offline evals in progress; perf suite partially run.
  - Validated: passed required quality thresholds + perf smoke on listed hardware.
  - Beta ready: validated + runtime/compat checks integrated + canary plan written.
  - Published: in profile library with signed artifacts + visible in Console (allowlist may still apply).
  - Blocked: known regression, incompatibility, or missing kernel path.

Assumptions / notes
- Expected savings ranges assume Hosted baseline BF16/FP16. Actual savings depend on seq length distribution, batching, cache hit rate, and routing tier.
- Hardware constraints are hard guardrails in v1 (policy engine must refuse/force fallback when out-of-bounds).
- “Max ctx” is a practical supported limit for the profile path (not necessarily the model’s theoretical limit).
- Owners are the “next action” owner, not the long-term DRI.

Rollup summary (as of last_modified)
- Beta ready (4): llama3.1-8b chat, qwen2.5-7b instruct, gte-large embed, (llama3.1-8b base is close but needs extra summarization check)
- Validated (3): llama3.1-8b base, qwen2.5-14b, bge-m3
- Eval running (3): llama3.1-70b fp8, qwen2.5-32b fp8, rerank-v2-7b
- Candidate (4): llama3.1-70b int8, mixtral-8x7b experts-int8, r1-distill-8b, llama2-13b
- Blocked (1): mistral-7b awq int4 (quality regression on code)

Open questions / TODOs
- Do we want to publish profiles that are “hardware-specific recommended” (e.g., gte-large on L4) as separate profile IDs vs a single ID with constraints? Current preference: single ID with constraints + Console hint.
- Need final wording for Console: “Experimental” vs “Beta” vs “Validated” (align with docs plan).
- For FP8 profiles: confirm deterministic kernel selection + trace annotation coverage is sufficient for customer debugging.

Change log (informal)
- 2025-03-08 (JW): updated qwen2.5 lines w/ 32k cap + runtime min version note; moved bge-m3 to Validated.
- 2025-03-06 (AD): llama3.1-8b and qwen2.5-7b marked Beta ready pending publish pipeline signoff.
